title: C gateway app: capability-announce callback (resolve sender pinned pubkey + record into table)
description: Follow-up to p7mv. The C capability table (lichen_capability_table_*) and the OSCORE-gated /.well-known/capability-announce CoAP resource (coap_server.c capability_announce_post) are landed, but no gateway-app callback is registered into s_handlers.capability_announce — so the resource returns 4.04 (NOT_FOUND) until one is. The callback must: (1) resolve the sender's pinned 32-byte Ed25519 pubkey from the OSCORE sender IID (oscore_sender_iid) — requires a C per-peer pinned-pubkey/trust store keyed by IID, which does not exist yet (only oscore_ctx_create_from_peer_key one-shot derivation exists); (2) call lichen_capability_announce_decode + lichen_capability_announce_verify with cached_seq from the table; (3) lichen_capability_table_record on success, set verdict 204/403/503. Blocked on: a C pinned-pubkey store keyed by node IID (analogous to Python CapabilityAnnounceResource's pubkey_resolver). Filed separately because that trust store is its own design decision for Mark (TOFU persistence, NVS). Wire into lichen/apps/gateway/src/main.c coap_handlers alongside .tunnel_auth.
